subject: Final commit gate: approval cadence, e-sign window, and Day 0 readiness
messages:
From: Sam Turner <sam@brightlane.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Joshi <p.joshi@brightlane.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and three-week kickoff window

Camila — thanks for the MAP and the walkthrough yesterday. We reviewed the timeline with our operations team. Two asks before we give final internal approval: (1) confirm the exact e-sign window length (we need at least 72 hours for procurement signoff) and (2) confirm that the start date can be moved by up to one week if our CISO needs to schedule an additional evidence review.

I attached a high-level procurement checklist for your reference.

—Sam

Attachments: procurement_checklist_brightlane.pdf (stub, 18kb)

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam@brightlane.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and three-week kickoff window

Sam — thanks, good questions. Short answers up front:
- E-sign window: we can open DocuSign for 7 calendar days by default; if you need a locked 72-hour SLA we can configure the envelope to require signatures within that period and set reminders at 24/48 hours.
- Start-date flexibility: yes — we can set the contract start date to be 'Start Date: upon successful signature and completion of preflight checks' with a calendar target and an allowance to move by up to 7 days without penalty.

I'm attaching the updated MAP workbook (Brightlane_MAP_v4.xlsx) and the SLA addendum you asked for. The SOW in v1.3 reflects the Day 0 runbook.

Next steps I propose:
1) Legal redline pass today so we can issue DocuSign by EOD tomorrow.
2) Exec signoff (Brightlane procurement + Redwood sales lead) targeted for Friday 6/19.
3) DocuSign envelope opens 6/19 10:00 PT, 7-day window, 72-hour hard requirement configured.
4) Tentative Day 0: 6/29 (buffered). If your CISO requests additional evidence, we shift Day 0 to 7/6 without fee — we document in the SOW.

If that aligns, I will loop in Marissa (contracts) and Monica (onboarding ops) to coordinate the final approvals and the DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,
Camila
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Brightlane_MAP_v4.xlsx (stub), Redwood_SLA_Addendum_v2.docx (stub), SOW_Brightlane_v1.3.pdf (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Final review: MAP + SLA addendum (internal)

Team — forwarding Sam's note and Camila's proposed cadence. Quick internal checklist before we send to Brightlane legal for redlines:
- Legal: confirm clause that allows 7-day e-sign envelope but enforces 72-hour mandatory signature block for procurement
- Finance: confirm invoicing milestone (we will invoice Day 0 + 30) — Monica?
- Onboarding: confirm Day 0 runbook timelines and that we can pause/resume provisioning if Day 0 shifts by a week

Monica — can you confirm invoicing language? Sean — need your final SLA note on uptime ramp (we proposed 99.5% in month 1 with 99.9% thereafter). If we get these signoffs by 12:00 PT today, Camila please send to Brightlane Legal for a redline pass.

—Marissa
VP, Customer Success

Quoted: "Camila — thanks, good questions..."

From: Brightlane Legal <legal@brightlane.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Sam Turner <sam@brightlane.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP and SLA addendum — redlines attached

Camila — attaching our redlines. Two primary items: (1) we want a defined escrow/backup data handling clause for the first 30 days; (2) we request that the e-sign envelope remains open for 10 days to allow legal countersignature if internal approvers are delayed. Procurement is okay with 72-hour internal approval once the envelope is open, but Legal prefers the 10-day window overall.

We are okay with the Day 0 flexibility language but want a short checklist of preflight items that, if not complete, will automatically push Day 0 and pause invoices. Please see attached redlined SOW.

Thanks,
Brightlane Legal

Attachments: SOW_Brightlane_v1.3_redlines.pdf (stub)

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam@brightlane.com>, Priya Joshi <p.joshi@brightlane.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP and SLA addendum — final cadence and DocuSign plan

Team — quick update and finalized plan after legal redlines: 
- We accepted the 10-day envelope window to satisfy Brightlane Legal, with a recommended internal procurement checkpoint that requires signatures within 72 hours of the envelope being sent. DocuSign will enforce the reminders but not lock the envelope.
- We added a preflight checklist to the SOW (see SOW_Brightlane_v1.3.pdf) that pauses provisioning and invoices if items remain open after 48 hours of attempted remediation.
- DocuSign envelope will be sent Mon 6/22 at 10:00 PT. Envelope will include the SOW, MAP workbook, and SLA addendum.
- Targeted sign-off milestone: procurement & exec approvals by Thu 6/25. Day 0 scheduled for Mon 6/29; if preflight extends, new Day 0 = Mon 7/6.

Action items:
- Camila: open DocuSign 6/22 (will paste link to HubSpot deal once envelope is live).
- Marissa + Sean: confirm final uptime ramp language by EOD Mon 6/22.
- Monica: confirm invoicing milestone language and supply AP contact for the invoice.

Sam/Priya — can you confirm internally that the 10-day envelope + 72-hour procurement checkpoint is acceptable? If yes, I will mark this thread as ready-to-send and attach the DocuSign link in HubSpot.

Thanks,
Camila
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
